# pruyn-paths-tests

Public test pages for Pruyn Paths, so storybooks can be tried on an iPhone by tapping a link.

Live site: https://trihards.github.io/pruyn-paths-tests/

The pages are the iPhone distribution test kit: two JavaScript checklist pages (small and 15 MB), a sample exported
storybook, and a photo-heavy storybook, plus phone-authoring checks: a map-tile check, a photo and file check, and a
work-in-progress build of the story editor. All data is synthetic: the trail is made up and the photos are generated images.

**This repository is a generated mirror. Do not edit it by hand.** It is published from the private Pruyn Paths
project, and the next publish overwrites any change made here.
